name: orbit-live
description: Opens Orbit Live in a terminal split beside the terminal your AI CLI (Claude Code, Codex) runs in, when Orbit asks. It runs Orbit's own viewer and nothing else.

orbit.live.storeDirs.description: Orbit stores to watch besides ~/.orbit/projects (set one when your terminals export ORBIT_STORE_DIR). Absolute paths, in your User or Remote settings only: a workspace cannot set this.

orbit.live.nodePath.description: Required: the absolute path of the node Orbit Live runs with (`command -v node` prints it). No PATH is searched; until it is set, nothing opens. In your User or Remote settings only.
